правки.было:
If a specific aspect ratio is needed for a new image and prompting does not produce it, the best practice is to provide a reference image with the correct dimensions as part of the prompt:
1. Image part: a blank (white) canvas of the target dimensions, passed before the text (for example 16:9 1280x720, 9:16 720x1280, 1:1 1024x1024).
2. Text: an explicit instruction tied to the canvas, for example "Render this scene on the provided canvas to match its 16:9 aspect ratio." or "make sure to use canvas for aspect ratio".
правки.стало:
If a specific aspect ratio is needed for a new image and prompting does not produce it, the best practice is to provide a reference image with the correct dimensions as part of the prompt:
1. Image part: a blank canvas with specific dimensions (for example 16:9 1280x720, 9:16 720x1280).
2. Text: an explicit instruction tied to the canvas, for example "Render this scene on the provided canvas to match its 16:9 aspect ratio." or "make sure to use canvas for aspect ratio".

правки.было: Canvas helper presets: 1:1 1024x1024, 3:4 768x1024, 4:3 1024x768, 9:16 720x1280, 16:9 1280x720 (not guaranteed output sizes). (models: nb25)
